The rendered page's `#security-state` section — Overview, the five remaining axis cards, Evidence, and Owner & model receipts — was extracted with the template's own inline `<style>` block and `templates/theme.css` into a standalone harness page with no other page chrome (nav, chart, other panels). These 8 captures are the evidence that Overview and Owner & model receipts read correctly in BOTH themes, not an assertion that they do. Recapture at head `2196ca82e14b1396b738169764d3e286a14194f0` (round 5): the section eyebrow now prints the panel count it measures (“8 reads” / “8 项读数”), the Overview coverage row prints the same two sentences in both languages, and R8's proven-path sentence carries the conditional workspace clause in both languages — all three are legible in these crops. The round-5 failure-code sentences are NOT depicted: the MSFT golden is a PROVEN identity proof with corroboration_state AVAILABLE, so all nine legs pass here and no failure copy can render on this fixture; those pairs are pinned by test_every_engine_failure_code_a_leg_can_carry_prints_a_house_sentence, not by these crops. The round-3 R1/R2 hedged copy is likewise not depicted, for the same reason. TOOL PROVENANCE: the 1.2.0 and 1.3.0 scripts were previous rounds' scratch files and were not preserved in the repository; 1.3.1 is another re-derivation of the method described above, not either of those files. The harness ran twice this round: once at d7b6e93b09f6 and again at this head after a comments-only commit corrected nine in-code engine citations. The eight PNGs are byte-identical between the two runs (same sha256, same byte counts), which is what a comments-only change should produce; only the head, the timestamp and the projection's own hash differ. Fidelity check: the desktop full-page geometry reproduces 1.3.0 exactly (1440x1823 EN, 1440x1801 ZH). The mobile heights grew (2671->2688 EN, 2516->2534 ZH) because the coverage row now prints two full sentences that wrap at 390px — a real copy change in this round's diff, not harness drift.

honesty.light_theme_judgment: Judged as a design, not a token swap: light renders a white/near-white cool canvas (`--bg`/`--panel2` light tokens already defined in `templates/theme.css`), hairline `1px` dividers on the R1..R9 receipt rows (`.ss-chk` border `--hair`), and dark ink text — a materially different surface from dark's luminance-depth translucent panel (`color-mix` of `--panel2` with transparent) and restrained rail glow. Chip elevation in light mixes the state hue with `#fff` rather than with `transparent` (the existing `[data-theme=light] .ss-cell` / `.ss-chip` rules). These 8 captures are the evidence that both new panels read correctly as a research-workspace surface in light and a command-center surface in dark.
